summary: Apply site screening, carbon baselining, and design evidence to development decisions. Explore the five-day course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Sustainable real estate development brings environmental and social criteria into planning, design, construction and handover. For property developers, project managers and built-environment professionals, the course supports screening site and stakeholder risks and carrying clear requirements into delivery. Participants practise preparing sustainability briefs, comparing whole-life carbon and material options, and documenting evidence for procurement, project reviews and handover.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape development requirements, assess project impacts, or carry sustainability decisions from design into construction and handover.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with real estate development, property design, construction, or project delivery is helpful. No coding or programming is required; exercises use project information and spreadsheet-based calculations.
